## For the reviewer: the lane this needed

Before merging, add one label for the review this change needed in your judgement, whatever floor the Change workflow printed in its summary:

- `lane:low`: nothing a person had to read
- `lane:medium`: one person reads it
- `lane:high`: a careful read, or a second person

Your label beside the floor is how the team learns whether the floor can be trusted.
